title: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Combined ratio of 85.9% drives underwriting income growth of 66.9% and record earnings Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE: ASIC) today announced financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company reported net income attributable to stockholders of $33.5 million, or $0.67 per diluted share, compared to $17.6 million, or $0.39 per diluted share, in the prior-year period. Adjusted net income attributable to stockholders (1) was $33.5 million, or $0.67 per diluted share (1) . Second Quarter 2026 Highlights Gross written premiums increased 23.4% to $206.8 million Net income attributable to stockholders was $33.5 million, or $0.67 per diluted share, up 89.8% Adjusted net income attributable to stockholders(1) was $33.5 million, or $0.67 per diluted share Combined ratio was 85.9%, compared to 88.9% in Q2 2025 Adjusted return on stockholders’ equity(1) was 20.7% Book value per share at quarter-end was $13.86 per share, up 8.5% from year-end Chief Executive
